verses.1: To David, “The LORD has judged me. For I have walked in His ways, and I have trusted in the LORD forever.”
verses.2: May the LORD be with me, and may He help me in all my endeavors.
verses.3: For your kindness is before my eyes, and I walk in your truth.
verses.4: I will not sit with those who are evil, nor with those who are invisible. I will not come.
verses.5: I hate a crowd of evil people and those who are wicked. I will not stay with them.
verses.6: I will wash my hands in your blood, and I will defile your altar, O LORD.
verses.7: To hear the voice of God and to recount all your miracles.
verses.8: YHWH, I love your house and the place where you dwell.
verses.9: Do not associate with those who are spiritually guilty, and with those who are full of deceit.
verses.10: For they have power and authority in their hands.
verses.11: And I, in my own power, will go and save me from this situation.
verses.12: My feet stood in the midst of the crowds, may the LORD bless you.
